description: This file defines a Screenshotter class responsible for capturing screenshots of web pages or elements within a web page, including handling styles, animations, masking, and clipping. It includes utility functions for preparing the page state before screenshots, managing a task queue, and validating options.

classes.name: Screenshotter
classes.description: Handles the process of taking screenshots of pages or elements, including setup, masking, and cleanup.

methods.name: _originalViewportSize
methods.description: Retrieves the current viewport size, either from the emulated size or by evaluating window.innerWidth/Height.

methods.name: _fullPageSize
methods.description: Calculates the full size of the page content for full-page screenshots.

methods.name: screenshotPage
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the entire page or a specified clip, handling full page logic.

methods.name: screenshotElement
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of a specific DOM element, ensuring it is visible and within viewport.

methods.name: _preparePageForScreenshot
methods.description: Prepares the page by disabling animations, hiding carets, and syncing styles before taking a screenshot.

methods.name: _restorePageAfterScreenshot
methods.description: Restores the page state after a screenshot, cleaning up any modifications.

methods.name: _maskElements
methods.description: Applies masking to specified elements to hide or obscure them in the screenshot.

methods.name: _screenshot
methods.description: Performs the actual screenshot operation, handling background, masking, and cleanup.
